items.title: Gap Mangione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I am off camera... [INTERVIEWEE] This is Greece.

ctx.x: Gap was interviewed in Rochester, NY on January 11, 2012, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I am off camera, in Greece, New York, right? We’re in Greece?
